# [Your Name] — writer-site

> Personal writing portfolio, blog, case study hub and public learning
> journal by [Your Name], a [role] in Rotterdam. Essays about craft and
> attention, breakdowns of shipped projects, and dated learning notes —
> including the parts that didn't work.

## Sections

- /writing — essays, tutorials, reflections and opinions. The finished arguments.
- /case-studies — long-form breakdowns of shipped work: constraints, process, sourced metrics, honest learnings.
- /journal — a public learning log: short dated notes, unedited on purpose.
- /projects — compact records of things built, some with full case studies.
- /archive — every published piece, filterable by type, category, tag and year.
- /about — who writes this.
- /newsletter — a letter every other Sunday: one essay, three links, one open problem.

## Feeds

- /rss.xml — everything
- /feed/writing.xml — writing only, full text
- /feed/journal.xml — journal only
- /feed.json — JSON Feed 1.1

## Themes

Craft, systems, attention, practice: how software gets made well, typography
and reading UX, learning in public.

## Reuse

Quote with attribution and a link. The full text of essays is in the writing
feed on purpose — take the argument, credit the author.
